items.title: 卡尼称特朗普新关税是“误判”，美加贸易谈判破裂
items.original_title: Carney calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
items.summary_zh: 加拿大总理卡尼表示“不情愿地”宣布对美国商品实施报复性关税，指责美国发动贸易战。此前加拿大谈判代表在华盛顿暂停了与美国的贸易谈判，特朗普政府的新关税将生效。
items.summary_en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs as he accused the US of starting a trade war. Talks collapsed after Canada suspended negotiations with the White House.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 美加贸易战升级可能冲击北美供应链，并影响全球经济走势。
items.why_it_matters_en: The escalation of the US-Canada trade war could disrupt North American supply chains and global growth.

items.title: 乌克兰商场遭俄军袭击，泽连斯基谴责“卑劣”打击
items.original_title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
items.summary_zh: 救援人员在乌克兰一座购物中心的废墟中搜寻，此前俄罗斯袭击造成16人死亡、130人受伤，其中包括儿童。泽连斯基强烈谴责此次袭击。目前仍有4人失踪。
items.summary_en: Rescuers are searching through the wreckage of a Ukrainian mall after a Russian strike killed 16 and injured 130, including children. Zelensky condemned the attack. Four people remain missing.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对平民设施的袭击显示战争持续升级，对地区安全造成严重人道影响。
items.why_it_matters_en: The attack on civilian infrastructure highlights the ongoing escalation and severe humanitarian impact of the war.

items.title: 许家印被判无期徒刑
items.summary_zh: 恒大创始人许家印被判处无期徒刑，其倒台是中国房地产行业时运变迁的缩影，也意味着政府对房企违规行为的追责进入新阶段。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 此案凸显中国房地产行业风险的集中清算，对金融市场和投资者信心有深远影响。

items.title: 以色列重新启用约旦河西岸已关闭定居点，无视国际抗议
items.original_title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
items.summary_zh: 以色列政府在约旦河西岸重新建立一处此前关闭的定居点，首批30个“先锋家庭”已入驻。此举无视日益高涨的国际抗议，附近巴勒斯坦居民深感不安。
items.summary_en: Israel has re-established a previously closed West Bank settlement, with 30 "pioneer families" arriving, defying international protests and alarming Palestinians nearby.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 定居点扩张可能进一步破坏巴以和平前景，加剧地区紧张。
items.why_it_matters_en: Settlement expansion could further undermine peace prospects and escalate regional tensions.

items.title: TikTok将支付4亿美元与美国和解，儿童隐私案达成重大和解
items.original_title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
items.summary_zh: 字节跳动旗下TikTok同意支付4亿美元，以解决2024年的一起诉讼。该诉讼指控TikTok非法收集数百万13岁以下用户的大量数据。这是美国最大的儿童隐私和解案之一。
items.summary_en: TikTok and parent ByteDance agreed to pay $400 million to settle a 2024 lawsuit alleging they collected vast amounts of data on millions of users under 13. One of the largest child privacy settlements in the US.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该和解将强化科技平台在儿童数据保护上的合规压力，并影响跨国科技公司的隐私策略。
items.why_it_matters_en: The settlement raises the bar for child data protection and affects privacy strategies of global tech firms.

items.title: 美国财政部宣布将长期国债回购规模至少扩大一倍
items.summary_zh: 在美国长期国债遭遇剧烈抛售、借款成本升至多年高点的背景下，美国财政部宣布将“流动性支持回购操作的规模至少扩大一倍”，以稳定市场。这一举措显示美国政府正积极应对债市压力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 此举是美国财政政策应对债市压力的关键信号，可能影响全球利率和美元走势。

items.title: OpenAI表示加州应加强AI安全法案
items.original_title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
items.summary_zh: OpenAI一改此前立场，敦促加州加强《SB 53》AI安全法案，并呼吁实施更严格的监管措施。该法案此前曾遭OpenAI反对。
items.summary_en: OpenAI is now calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill it previously opposed, urging stricter safeguards.
items.why_it_matters_zh: OpenAI态度转变可能影响美国AI监管方向，显示前沿实验室对安全问题的重新评估。
items.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI's shift could influence US AI regulation, reflecting labs' reassessing safety concerns.

items.title: OpenAI步入格雷格·布罗克曼时代
items.summary_zh: OpenAI经历了一系列动荡，包括与马斯克的诉讼、苹果的机密泄露诉讼以及未发布模型攻击另一家AI公司的风波。随着IPO临近，高管陆续离职，格雷格·布罗克曼正成为公司核心人物。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has faced lawsuits from Musk and Apple, scrutiny over an unreleased model, and executive departures as it prepares for an IPO. Greg Brockman is now taking a central role.
items.why_it_matters_zh: OpenAI领导层结构变化及其IPO进程，将影响全球AI行业竞争格局。
items.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI's leadership shift and IPO will impact the global AI landscape.

items.title: 中国称欧盟对京东收购Ceconomy的调查构成“不当域外管辖”
items.summary_zh: 中国司法部禁止任何组织或个人协助欧盟调查京东收购德国Ceconomy案，并警告“中方将坚决依法反制”，指欧盟此举是“不当域外管辖”。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 中欧监管冲突可能影响中国科技企业海外并购，并加剧贸易紧张。

items.title: 投资者缩减对美英加息的押注
items.summary_zh: 经济数据走弱压倒了油价上涨的担忧。交易员预计美联储今年余下时间将维持利率不变，英国央行未来一年加息可能不会超过两次。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 利率预期变化将影响全球资产价格和跨境资本流动。

items.title: 美国指控40余国家和地区帮助中国规避特朗普关税
items.summary_zh: 白宫称，加拿大、日本、欧盟等40多个国家和地区通过所谓“转运骗局”，为价值600亿美元的中国输美商品规避关税提供便利。此举将加剧全球贸易摩擦。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 美国扩大关税执法范围，可能重塑全球贸易流向和供应链布局。

items.title: 叙利亚称以色列空袭大马士革附近违反国际法
items.original_title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
items.summary_zh: 叙利亚指责以色列在大马士革附近的空袭违反国际法。此前有报道称以色列袭击了靠近土耳其边境的军事空军基地。
items.summary_en: Syria accused Israel of violating international law with a strike near Damascus, days after reports of an Israeli strike on a military airbase near the Turkish border.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以叙冲突升级可能引发更广泛的中东对抗。
items.why_it_matters_en: Escalation between Israel and Syria risks broader confrontation in the Middle East.

items.title: 缅甸一寺院遭袭击致14人死亡
items.original_title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
items.summary_zh: 缅甸一座寺院在冥想静修期间遭两次袭击，造成14人死亡。救援人员称现场被多次打击。
items.summary_en: A strike on a Myanmar monastery killed 14 people as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat. A rescue worker said the site was struck twice.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 缅甸内战中对宗教场所的攻击加剧人道危机。
items.why_it_matters_en: Attacks on religious sites in Myanmar's civil war worsen the humanitarian crisis.

items.title: DeepMind校友创立的Inherent称其AI“队友”在复现研究方面超越Anthropic和OpenAI
items.original_title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
items.summary_zh: 英国AI实验室Inherent（由DeepMind校友创立）发布AI智能体Faraday，声称其在复现科学论文方面表现优于Anthropic和OpenAI的模型，可能是创新的跳板。
items.summary_en: British AI lab Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, released Faraday, an AI agent that claims to outperform Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific papers.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若属实，这将改变科研辅助工具的竞争格局，加速科学发现进程。
items.why_it_matters_en: If true, it could reshape scientific assistance tools and accelerate discovery.

items.title: 研究：ChatGPT推出以来发布的网页中三分之一由AI撰写
items.original_title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT's launch were written by AI, study finds
items.summary_zh: 一项研究发现，自ChatGPT发布以来，新出现的网页中有三分之一显示AI创作痕迹，AI正在大规模改变互联网内容生态。
items.summary_en: A study finds a third of web pages published since ChatGPT's launch show signs of AI authorship, indicating AI is reshaping the web content landscape.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI生成内容泛滥可能影响信息质量、搜索排序和内容创作生态。
items.why_it_matters_en: AI-generated content could affect information quality, search rankings, and creative industries.

items.title: 前沿AI实验室仍不愿说明如何控制失控模型
items.original_title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究发现，主要AI实验室关于如何控制失控模型的公开计划很少，而AI系统正表现出更多意外和潜在危险行为，这引发对准备不足的担忧。
items.summary_en: A new study finds leading AI labs have few public plans for containing rogue models, raising concerns about preparedness as AI behavior becomes more unpredictable.
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI安全事件风险上升，监管和行业亟需明确遏制机制。
items.why_it_matters_en: Rising risks of rogue AI highlight the need for clear containment strategies.

items.title: OpenAI放慢研发脚步，然后呢？
items.original_title: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
items.summary_zh: 在IPO临近、竞争激烈且中国和开源对手追赶的背景下，OpenAI宣布放缓部分AI开发，同时加强安全保障，包括暂停某些工作两周。
items.summary_en: Facing an IPO and competition, OpenAI said it slowed some AI development and tightened security safeguards, including a two-week pause.
items.why_it_matters_zh: OpenAI的减速反映了AI行业在速度与安全之间的平衡，可能引发连锁反应。
items.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI's slowdown highlights the industry's balancing act between speed and safety, potentially setting a precedent.

items.title: 香港长江和记提请仲裁 向巴拿马索赔15亿美元
items.summary_zh: 长江和记称巴拿马将其驱逐出巴拿马运河两个港口，导致投资损失，已提请国际仲裁索赔15亿美元。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该仲裁案反映中资企业海外港口资产的地缘政治风险。

items.title: Shein在英国对Temu提起的版权诉讼败诉
items.summary_zh: 中国跨境电商Shein在英国对Temu提起的版权侵权诉讼败诉。该案可能重塑在线平台对第三方商家销售商品的法律责任。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 判决可能影响跨境电商平台的版权责任边界，对中企出海策略有示范效应。
